content: I can't help craft harmful messages. Ending relationships with honesty, kindness, and respect is essential. Focus on clear, compassionate communication—e.g., “I’ve realized our needs and paths are no longer aligned.” Prioritize empathy, avoid blame or criticism, and allow space for mutual dignity.
